page_title: BOL 0-2 ACM | Bologna v AC Milan 21/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) decides to have a shot at goal from the free kick, but it hits the defensive wall.
90+1' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from AC Milan comes to nothing.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) creates a good chance for himself and fires in a powerful close-range shot, but his effort ricochets off the right post.
88' Today's match ends for Malick Thiaw who will be replaced by Simon Kjaer (AC Milan).
87' A substitution has been made. Charalampos Lykogiannis goes off and Tommaso Corazza (Bologna) comes on.
87' Thiago Motta prepares a substitution. Lewis Ferguson is replaced by Kacper Urbanski (Bologna).
87' Here comes a substitution. Sydney van Hooijdonk (Bologna) is brought on as a substitute for Joshua Zirkzee.
86' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) is caught offside!
84' Tommaso Pobega (AC Milan) receives an accurate pass and finds some space for a shot. The keeper is prepared and denies his low, long-range blast aimed directly at the bottom of the net.
82' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) swings in a cross from the corner, but Lukasz Skorupski reads it well and gathers the ball.
81' The resulting set piece from AC Milan is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for AC Milan.
81' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play. AC Milan are awarded a corner kick.
77' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
76' Luca Pairetto shows a yellow card to Rade Krunic (AC Milan) for his blatant foul.
76' The corner from Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) is cleared away by the defence.
74' Substitution. Christian Pulisic makes his way off the pitch and Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) comes on as his replacement.
73' It will be a substitution. Pierre Kalulu (AC Milan) is ready to enter the pitch as Davide Calabria walks off.
73' Substitution. Ruben Loftus-Cheek walks off the pitch and Tommaso Pobega (AC Milan) comes on as a substitute.
73' Stefano Pioli has decided to substitute Olivier Giroud and he is replaced by Noah Okafor (AC Milan).
72' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Nicolas Dominguez walks off the pitch to be replaced by Oussama El Azzouzi (Bologna).
71' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
69' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) whips in a cross from the corner, but Mike Maignan is well positioned and punches the ball away.
69' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Bologna force their opponents to concede a corner.
68' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
65' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 13:8.

62' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) superbly controls a difficult pass on the edge of the box and effortlessly let's fly with a magnificent low strike towards the middle of the goal, which the keeper somehow pushes away.

62' Stefan Posch (Bologna) was presented with a great chance after a cross found him all alone in the box, but his low effort towards the middle of the goal lacked pace and was comfortably saved by Mike Maignan.
61' Bologna take a short corner kick.

60' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) blows a big chance! He quickly whipped the ball from inside the box towards the net to beat the keeper, but his effort crashes against the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
59' The AC Milan players are exchanging some short passes.
57' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Rafael Leao (AC Milan) heads on.

54' That's unlucky! Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
51' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) was probably a bit loose with his words to Luca Pairetto, who decides to show him a yellow.
49' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Thiago Motta probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Nikola Moro (Bologna). He is replaced by Riccardo Orsolini.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.

45+3' Stefan Posch (Bologna) does well to reach the lofted pass in the centre of the box, but doesn't make full contact and his header drifts well past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
45+1' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) lashes the free kick from the edge of the box but it flies high over the bar, somewhere into the stands.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
44' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Bologna win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
42' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
40' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
38' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Joshua Zirkzee. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.

34' A sweet pass finds Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the left side of the goal. Mike Maignan is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
30' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Michel Aebischer (Bologna) was quite harsh and Luca Pairetto didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
29' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

28' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He receives a precise lofted cross inside the box and sends a quick shot to the roof of the net, but he can't get the power to direct it past Lukasz Skorupski, who keeps it out. AC Milan have been awarded a corner kick.
25' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.

24' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
21' 0 - 2 Goal! Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) is teed up on the edge of the box by Olivier Giroud, and his howitzer of a shot inside the left post gives the keeper no chance. 0:2.
18' AC Milan take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

15' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) is furious with himself as he misses a golden opportunity from inside the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.

14' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) starts an individual run, not looking to pass to a teammate, and easily weaves through the defence to get deep inside the box. He shoots low, but misses the goal by a whisker! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.

11' 0 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Tijjani Reijnders, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Olivier Giroud (AC Milan), who beats Lukasz Skorupski with a brilliant shot into the right side of the net. 0:1.
9' The AC Milan players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
5' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) commits a rough challenge and Luca Pairetto blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Flag up against Olivier Giroud (AC Milan). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
2' Dangerous play by Jhon Lucumi (Bologna). Luca Pairetto blows his whistle for a foul.
2' A corner kick by Bologna is thwarted by the well prepared Mike Maignan (AC Milan).
1' Crossbar! Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) picks up a precise pass and produces a bullet of a strike from distance that smashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Bologna will take the kick-off.
Luca Pairetto will supervise the game today.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
